environment: Windows / PowerShell / local loopback; PG readonly metadata + SQLite mode=ro PRAGMA

registration.compared_fields: column order/type/null/default/identity + PK/UNIQUE/FK names/ordered columns/actions/validation; CHECK definitions collected, not expression-normalized

analysis_artifacts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE analysis_artifacts (
                artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

analysis_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE analysis_events (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,id))

analysis_results.ddl:
CREATE TABLE analysis_results (
                result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

analysis_runs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE analysis_runs (
                run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                client_request_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(conversation_id,turn_id))

indexes.name: analysis_one_active
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX analysis_one_active ON analysis_runs(conversation_id)
                WHERE status IN ('queued','running','awaiting_answer','awaiting_approval')

jobs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
                    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, approval_id TEXT, plan_id TEXT, revision INTEGER,
                    digest TEXT, expires_at REAL, status TEXT, result TEXT, aws INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sql_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', delivery_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required', agent_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required', agent_reply TEXT,
                    UNIQUE(plan_id, digest))

outbox.ddl:
CREATE TABLE outbox (
                    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

plans.ddl:
CREATE TABLE plans (
                    plan_id TEXT, revision INTEGER, digest TEXT, payload TEXT,
                    PRIMARY KEY(plan_id, revision))

artifacts.ddl: CREATE TABLE "artifacts" ("id" varchar not null, "turn_id" varchar not null, "conversation_id" varchar not null, "sha256" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("turn_id") references "turns"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("conversation_id") references "conversations"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("id"))

conversations.ddl: CREATE TABLE "conversations" ("id" varchar not null, "title" varchar not null, "confirmed_conditions" text not null default '{}', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

migrations.ddl: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)

turns.ddl: CREATE TABLE "turns" ("id" varchar not null, "conversation_id" varchar not null, "position" integer not null, "client_request_id" varchar not null, "input" text not null, "input_hash" varchar not null, "run_id" varchar, "status" varchar not null, "snapshot" text not null default '{}', "events" text not null default '[]', "transport_error" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("conversation_id") references "conversations"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("id"))
